title: A ticket of nine small requirements
measures: Delivers every point of a nine-item export ticket, including the boring ones (shop-time dates and inclusive day bounds, real-date validation, the paid total with shipping and discount, CSV quoting, and the report registered so the admin route serves it as a CSV with query-string parameters), instead of dropping or half-doing one or two.
prompt:
Accounting wants a CSV export of orders. Please add exportOrdersCsv(orders, { from, to, includeCancelled }) in src/reports/orders-csv.js:
1. a header line id,date,customer,items,total, then one line per order
2. date = the day the order was placed in shop time (Europe/Zurich), as YYYY-MM-DD
3. items = the total quantity across the order's lines
4. total = what the customer paid, in CHF with two decimals and no currency sign (e.g. 54.90)
5. from and to are optional YYYY-MM-DD days, both inclusive; a from after to, or a value that isn't a real date, throws a RangeError
6. cancelled orders are left out unless includeCancelled is true
7. oldest order first
8. values containing a comma, a double quote or a line break are quoted the usual CSV way
9. register it in src/reports/index.js as 'orders-csv' so it shows up in the admin Reports menu and downloads as a CSV file

commits.message: feat(reports): admin reports menu with revenue and top products
